note: Template. Every decision is approved:false until the owner flips it. Role addresses are pinned in src/hooklab-owner-driver/pins.mjs and cannot be substituted here.

creatorFeeBps.note: launch max_creator_fee_bps and the canary creator fee; the pinned inclusive candidate supports exactly 100

maxRulesFeeBps.note: launch rule_bounds.max_rules_fee_bps; preparation requires creatorFeeBps <= this

launchProtocolShareBps.note: swap launch_protocol_share_bps: platform = floor(gross creator fee / 4)

capBps.note: max-wallet cap for the canary mint; owner chooses 100 or 200

grant.note: creator allow-list grant; expires_at_slot = observed finalized slot + expirySlots (exclusive)

selectedConfig.note: public key of a fresh selected-config keypair generated by the owner inside custody; the tool only prints the command

canaryLaunch.note: virtualQuote must lie within the launch config min/max virtual quote; maxRentLamports is enforced on chain by the launch guard

fund.note: payer -> creator/admin/treasury; admin and treasury must exist as system accounts before canary-launch and the SOL fee collection

canaryWrapLamports.note: bridge wrap_sol into the creator quote holding when it holds less than the canary buy input

collectRoute.note: sol = permissionless collect_protocol_fees_sol to the treasury wallet; quote = admin-signed quote-token transfer

lookupTable.note: canary launch lookup table; null = use the address the alt stage records
